description: P0 smoke evaluation dataset for the NVIDIA NIM Operator uninstall skill.

test_cases.prompt: Use the NIM Operator uninstall skill to inventory my current NIM Operator installation. Do not delete anything.
test_cases.ground_truth: The agent runs read-only inventory only, reports Helm release and namespace state, lists CRDs and custom resources, and does not run helm uninstall or kubectl delete.
expected_behavior: Runs the bundled validation helper as the first inventory step.
Separates read-only inventory from destructive uninstall actions.
Reports whether the Helm release, namespace resources, CRDs, and custom resources exist.
Does not delete CRDs, custom resources, namespaces, or dependencies.

test_cases.prompt: Use the NIM Operator uninstall skill to uninstall the nim-operator release from the nim-operator namespace. Preserve CRDs, custom resources, namespace, GPU Operator, cert-manager, and KServe.
test_cases.ground_truth: The agent inventories the installation, asks before running helm uninstall, removes only the Helm release after approval, reruns validation, and confirms preserved CRDs and dependencies.
expected_behavior: Runs the bundled validation helper before proposing destructive commands.
Shows the exact helm uninstall nim-operator -n nim-operator command before execution.
Requires explicit approval before helm uninstall.
Does not delete CRDs or custom resources because the prompt says to preserve them.
Does not remove GPU Operator, cert-manager, KServe, or shared dependencies.
Runs post-uninstall validation after the Helm release removal.

test_cases.prompt: Install NIM Operator on my Kubernetes cluster from the NVIDIA Helm repo.
test_cases.ground_truth: The uninstall skill should not trigger because the user is asking for an install workflow.
expected_behavior: Does not use the NIM Operator uninstall skill.
Does not run the uninstall validation helper.
Routes the task to the install skill or asks to use the install workflow.
